freeAI.qwen.browserMode.markdownDescription: How the Qwen anti-bot (WAF) fallback browser runs. `auto` is recommended. Changing this needs a window reload.

freeAI.mimo.path.markdownDescription: Path to the MiMo Code CLI executable (`mimo`). Leave empty to auto-detect in `~/.mimocode/bin` and `PATH`. The provider talks to a local `mimo serve` process, so no API key is needed — sign-in lives in the CLI.

freeAI.debug.description: Enable verbose DEBUG logs in the 'AI Free VSCode' output channel (auth flow, requests, streaming). Useful for troubleshooting.

freeAI.commit.enabled.description: Show the ✨ commit message generation button in the Source Control view.

freeAI.commit.model.markdownDescription: Model for commit message generation. `auto` = first available. You can set a model id/family/name or pick one via the **AI Free VSCode — Change Commit Model** command.

freeAI.commit.prompt.default:
Generate a commit message for the git diff below.
Requirements:
- Use Conventional Commits format: type(scope): summary (type = feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore).
- Subject on a single line, imperative mood, max 72 characters.
- Write the message in English.
- For significant changes, add a short body after a blank line (a bullet list is allowed).
- Reply with ONLY the commit message text: no markdown fences, no quotes, no explanations.
freeAI.commit.prompt.markdownDescription: Instruction (prompt) for commit message generation. The git diff is appended to it automatically.

freeAI.suggestions.enabled.description: Enable on-demand code suggestions from the free models. They never appear while you type: trigger them with the 'AI Free VSCode — Suggest Code at Cursor' command or the Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+\ hotkey, and the result is inserted as ghost text. Note: latency is higher than Copilot.

freeAI.suggestions.model.markdownDescription: Model for inline suggestions. `auto` = first available. You can set a model id/family/name or pick one via the **AI Free VSCode — Change Completions Model** command.

freeAI.suggestions.maxPrefixChars.description: How many characters of code BEFORE the cursor to send to the model.

freeAI.suggestions.maxSuffixChars.description: How many characters of code AFTER the cursor to send to the model.

freeAI.fix.enabled.description: Show the 'Fix with AI Free' action in the Quick Fix lightbulb (⌘./Ctrl+.) on errors and warnings.

freeAI.fix.model.markdownDescription: Model for fixing problems. `auto` = first available. You can set a model id/family/name or pick one via the **AI Free VSCode — Change Fix Model** command.
